name: yangweijie/typephp-gui
description: TypePHP GUI application template (not a Packagist library): compiled PHP backend + in-tree tinyjsapp host. Consume via bootstrap.php or the PSR-4 autoload below; do not require this as a reusable Composer package.

scripts-descriptions.test: Headless protocol smoke tests (Windows-safe: php, not bash).
scripts-descriptions.verify: Verify a packaged dist/ bundle: launcher subsystem, bundled launcher, DLL set. POSIX host-probe kit remains test/posix/all.sh (bash).
